50	    """Resolve the hostname in base_url on the host and return {hostname: ip}.

54	    returned (local inference servers like vidar/bragi have routable IPs).

60	        parsed = urlparse(base_url)

63	            return {}

578	                output = data.get("output", "")
579	                err = data.get("error", "")
580	                for step in reversed(steps):

603	            "agent": {
604	                "name": "fiz",
605	                "version": self.version() or "unknown",

613	                "total_cost_usd": total_cost,

26	    def apply_profile(self, profile: BenchmarkProfile) -> CommandSpec:
27	        env: dict[str, str] = {
28	            "FIZEAU_BASE_URL": profile.provider.base_url,
29	            "FIZEAU_MODEL": profile.provider.model,
30	            "FIZEAU_API_KEY": os.environ.get(profile.provider.api_key_env, ""),

35	            env["FIZEAU_PROVIDER"] = profile.provider.type
36	        # Forward sampling params so fiz reads them via FIZEAU_* env overrides.
37	        sampling = getattr(profile, "sampling", None) or {}
38	        if isinstance(sampling, dict):
39	            if (t := sampling.get("temperature")) is not None:
40	                env["FIZEAU_TEMPERATURE"] = str(t)
41	            if (v := sampling.get("top_p")) is not None:
42	                env["FIZEAU_TOP_P"] = str(v)
43	            if (v := sampling.get("top_k")) is not None:
44	                env["FIZEAU_TOP_K"] = str(int(v))
45	            if (v := sampling.get("min_p")) is not None:
46	                env["FIZEAU_MIN_P"] = str(v)

50	        applied = self.apply_profile(profile)
51	        binary = shutil.which("fiz") or "/installed-agent/fiz"
52	        argv = [
53	            binary,
54	            "--json",
55	            "--preset",
56	            "default",
57	            "--work-dir",
58	            workdir or ".",
59	            "-p",
60	            prompt,
61	        ]

64	    def parse_telemetry(self, stream: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
65	        telemetry = empty_telemetry()
66	        for event in jsonl_objects(stream):
67	            if event.get("type") not in {"session.end", "final"}:
68	                continue
69	            data = event.get("data")
70	            if isinstance(data, dict):
71	                usage = data.get("usage") or {}
72	                telemetry["input_tokens"] = usage.get("input") or usage.get("input_tokens")

155	# register_inflight registers a cell as in-flight in the state file.
156	# Reads current entries, adds this cell, removes dead PIDs, writes back.
157	register_inflight() {
158	  local cell_id="$1" cell_dir="$2"
159	  local state_dir
160	  state_dir="$(in_flight_state_dir)"
161	  mkdir -p "${state_dir}"
162	  local json_path
163	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
164	
165	  local current_json="{\"cells\":[]}"
166	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] && current_json="$(cat "${json_path}")" || true
167	
168	  # Prune dead PIDs by filtering in bash
169	  local live_cells=()
170	  local cell_json pid
171	  while IFS= read -r cell_json; do
172	    [[ -z "${cell_json}" ]] && continue
173	    pid="$(jq -r '.pid' <<<"${cell_json}")"
174	    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
175	      live_cells+=("${cell_json}")
176	    fi
177	  done < <(jq -r '.cells[] | @json' <<<"${current_json}")
178	
179	  # Rebuild with live cells
180	  current_json="$(printf '%s\n' "${live_cells[@]}" | jq -s '{cells:.}')"
181	
182	  # Add this cell
183	  current_json="$(jq \
184	    --arg cell_id "${cell_id}" \
185	    --arg cell_dir "${cell_dir}" \
186	    --argjson pid "${BASHPID}" \
187	    '.cells += [{cell_id:$cell_id, cell_dir:$cell_dir, pid:$pid}]' \
188	    <<<"${current_json}")"

190	  printf '%s\n' "${current_json}" >"${json_path}.tmp"
191	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"

212	# interrupt_inflight_cells is called during signal handling. For each in-flight cell:
213	#   1. SIGTERM the cell's process group
214	#   2. Write interrupted report for cells that don't have one
215	#   3. docker stop containers matching the cell's label (--time=30s grace)
216	#   4. Wait up to grace_seconds for containers to stop
217	#   5. Force-kill any stragglers with docker kill
218	# Also removes the cell from in-flight.json.
219	interrupt_inflight_cells() {
220	  local grace_seconds="${BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS:-30}"
221	  local json_path
222	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
223	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] || return 0
224	
225	  local cells
226	  cells="$(jq -r '.cells[] | @json' "${json_path}")" || return 0
227	
228	  local cell_id cell_dir pid
229	  local cell_count=0
230	  local cells_to_kill=()
231	
232	  while IFS= read -r cell_json; do
233	    [[ -z "${cell_json}" ]] && continue
234	    cell_id="$(jq -r '.cell_id' <<<"${cell_json}")"
235	    cell_dir="$(jq -r '.cell_dir' <<<"${cell_json}")"
236	    pid="$(jq -r '.pid' <<<"${cell_json}")"
237	
238	    [[ -n "${cell_id}" ]] || continue
239	    cells_to_kill+=("${cell_id}:${pid}:${cell_dir}")
240	    cell_count=$((cell_count + 1))
241	
242	    # SIGTERM the cell's process group (try both negative PID for process group and regular PID)
243	    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && (( pid > 0 )); then
244	      kill -TERM -"${pid}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "${pid}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
245	    fi
246	
247	    # Write interrupted report if metadata file exists and no report yet
248	    if [[ -f "${cell_dir}/.interrupt-metadata" && ! -f "${cell_dir}/report.json" ]]; then
249	      source "${cell_dir}/.interrupt-metadata" || continue
250	      write_interrupted_cell_report "${cell_id}" "${cell_dir}" "${profile_id}" "${te_ver}" "${hd}" "${task}" || true
251	    fi
252	  done <<<"${cells}"
253	
254	  # If there are containers to stop, do so with a grace period
255	  if [[ ${cell_count} -gt 0 ]]; then
256	    for cell_spec in "${cells_to_kill[@]}"; do
257	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*:*}"
258	      docker ps -q --filter "label=fizeau-cell=${cell_id}" 2>/dev/null \
259	        | xargs -r docker stop --time=30 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
260	    done
261	
262	    # Wait a bit for containers to actually stop
263	    sleep 2
264	
265	    # Force-kill any remaining containers that didn't stop
266	    for cell_spec in "${cells_to_kill[@]}"; do
267	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*:*}"
268	      docker ps -q --filter "label=fizeau-cell=${cell_id}" 2>/dev/null \
269	        | xargs -r docker kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
270	    done
271	  fi
272	
273	  # Clear in-flight entries (they should have trap handlers that do this too, but be explicit)
274	  : >"${json_path}.tmp"
275	  printf '{"cells":[]}\n' >"${json_path}.tmp"
276	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"
277	}

399	# resolve_tasks emits one task id per line for a bench-set.
400	# Handles three shapes:
401	#   tasks: [id, id, ...]         inline list
402	#   tasks: all                   defer to harness dataset; emit "*all*"
403	#   tasks_from: <path>           load tasks[].id from a sibling YAML
404	# tasks_from and inline tasks merge in deterministic order with duplicates
405	# removed on first occurrence.
406	resolve_tasks() {
407	  local bs_file="$1"
408	  local bs_json tasks_kind tasks_from
409	  bs_json="$(bench_set_json "${bs_file}")"
410	
411	  tasks_kind="$(jq -r '
412	    if (.tasks // null) == null then "none"
413	    elif (.tasks | type) == "array" then "list"
414	    elif (.tasks | type) == "string" then ("string:" + .tasks)
415	    else "other"
416	    end' <<<"${bs_json}")"
417	
418	  tasks_from="$(jq -r '.tasks_from // ""' <<<"${bs_json}")"
419	
420	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "string:all" ]]; then
421	    [[ -z "${tasks_from}" ]] || die "bench-set ${bs_file}: tasks: all cannot be combined with tasks_from"
422	    # Defer to the harness dataset. The plan path emits a sentinel so
423	    # operators see the contract; the run path (PR A4) expands at execution.
424	    printf '*all*\n'
425	    return 0
426	  fi
427	
428	  local -A seen_tasks=()
429	  local emitted=0
430	  local task resolved
431	
432	  emit_task() {
433	    local task="$1"
434	    [[ -n "${task}" ]] || return 0
435	    if [[ -z "${seen_tasks["${task}"]+x}" ]]; then
436	      seen_tasks["${task}"]=1
437	      printf '%s\n' "${task}"
438	      emitted=1
439	    fi
440	  }
441	
442	  if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" ]]; then
443	    resolved="$(cd "$(dirname "${bs_file}")" && cd "$(dirname "${tasks_from}")" && pwd)/$(basename "${tasks_from}")"
444	    [[ -f "${resolved}" ]] || die "tasks_from path not found: ${tasks_from} (resolved to ${resolved})"
445	    while IFS= read -r task; do
446	      emit_task "${task}"
447	    done < <(
448	      yq -o=json '.' "${resolved}" \
449	        | jq -r '
450	            .tasks[]?
451	            | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
452	          '
453	    )
454	  fi
455	
456	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
457	    while IFS= read -r task; do
458	      emit_task "${task}"
459	    done < <(jq -r '
460	      .tasks[] | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
461	    ' <<<"${bs_json}")
462	  elif [[ "${tasks_kind}" != "none" ]]; then
463	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: unsupported tasks shape"
464	  fi
465	
466	  if [[ ${emitted} -eq 0 ]]; then
467	    if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" || "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
468	      die "bench-set ${bs_file}: resolved no tasks"
469	    fi
470	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: no .tasks list, .tasks: all, or .tasks_from set"
471	  fi
472	}

781	compute_harbor_source_sha() {

1007	# Invoke the task-executor with bounded exponential backoff on transient
1008	# errors. Returns 0 on success; non-zero on terminal failure after retries.
1009	# Captures attempts log to ${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt for forensics.
1010	run_executor_with_retry() {
1011	  local task_spec="$1" cell_dir="$2" executor="$3"
1012	  local stderr_file
1013	  stderr_file="$(mktemp)"
1014	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1015	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1016	  local attempt=1
1017	  local status=0
1018	  local retry_log="${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt"
1019	  : >"${retry_log}"
1020	  while :; do
1021	    : >"${stderr_file}"
1022	    set +e
1023	    printf '%s' "${task_spec}" | "${executor}" 2>"${stderr_file}" >/dev/null
1024	    status=$?
1025	    set -e
1026	    printf 'attempt=%d status=%d\n' "${attempt}" "${status}" >>"${retry_log}"
1027	    if [[ ${status} -eq 0 ]]; then
1028	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1029	      return 0
1030	    fi
1031	    cat "${stderr_file}" >>"${retry_log}"
1032	    if (( attempt > max_attempts )) || ! is_transient_stderr "${stderr_file}"; then
1033	      cat "${stderr_file}" >&2
1034	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1035	      return "${status}"
1036	    fi
1037	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}); sleeping ${backoff}s"
1038	    sleep "${backoff}"
1039	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1040	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1041	  done
1042	}

1100	# compute_cell_cost prints the cost_usd_at_run_time for a single cell. Uses
1101	# profile.pricing × token streams pulled from the cell's result.json. Token
1102	# field names follow the canonical report-level naming
1103	# (input_tokens / output_tokens / cached_input_tokens) and are also probed
1104	# under the harbor totals naming (total_prompt_tokens / total_completion_tokens
1105	# / total_cached_input_tokens) so harness-native token reporters land in the
1106	# same accumulator.
1107	#
1108	# When profile.pricing is all zero (or unset) and the executor wrote an
1109	# explicit cost_usd / total_cost_usd in result.json, the explicit value is
1110	# honored — that lets harnesses that observe API-reported cost directly
1111	# participate in budget enforcement.
1112	compute_cell_cost() {
1113	  local result_json="${1:-}" profile_json="${2:-}"
1114	  [[ -n "${result_json}" ]] || result_json='{}'
1115	  [[ -n "${profile_json}" ]] || profile_json='{}'
1116	  jq -nr \
1117	    --argjson result "${result_json}" \
1118	    --argjson profile "${profile_json}" \
1119	    '
1120	      def num(v): if (v == null) then 0 else (v | tonumber? // 0) end;
1121	      ($profile.pricing // {}) as $p
1122	      | num($p.input_usd_per_mtok)         as $pi
1123	      | num($p.output_usd_per_mtok)        as $po
1124	      | num($p.cached_input_usd_per_mtok)  as $pc
1125	      | num($result.input_tokens
1126	            // $result.total_prompt_tokens
1127	            // $result.n_input_tokens
1128	            // 0)                          as $ti
1129	      | num($result.output_tokens
1130	            // $result.total_completion_tokens
1131	            // $result.n_output_tokens
1132	            // 0)                          as $to
1133	      | num($result.cached_input_tokens
1134	            // $result.total_cached_input_tokens
1135	            // $result.n_cached_input_tokens
1136	            // 0)                          as $tc
1137	      | num($result.cost_usd // $result.total_cost_usd // 0) as $reported
1138	      | (($ti * $pi) + ($to * $po) + ($tc * $pc)) / 1000000  as $priced
1139	      | (if $priced > 0 then $priced
1140	         elif ($pi + $po + $pc) == 0 then $reported
1141	         else 0
1142	         end)
1143	      | tostring
1144	    '
1145	}

1495	# run_cell_with_per_cell_retry invokes run_one_cell with per-cell retry logic
1496	# for transient errors. Each retry attempt gets a fresh cell_id and cell_dir,
1497	# linked via attempt_of/superseded_by. Returns the final cell_dir.
1498	# initial_attempt_of="" disables initial attempt_of tracking.
1499	run_cell_with_per_cell_retry() {
1500	  local out="$1" profile_id="$2" profile_file="$3"
1501	  local framework="$4" dataset="$5" dataset_dir="$6" task="$7"
1502	  local rep_idx="$8" total_reps="$9" adapter="${10}"
1503	  local te_ver="${11}" hd="${12}" interrupted_flag="${13:-}" initial_attempt_of="${14:-}"
1504	
1505	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1506	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1507	  local attempt=1
1508	  local prior_cell_dir="${initial_attempt_of}"
1509	
1510	  while :; do
1511	    local cell_dir
1512	    cell_dir="$(run_one_cell "${out}" "${profile_id}" "${profile_file}" \
1513	                  "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1514	                  "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${adapter}" "${prior_cell_dir}" \
1515	                  "${te_ver}" "${hd}" "${interrupted_flag}")"
1516	
1517	    if [[ ! -f "${cell_dir}/report.json" ]]; then
1518	      # No result to check, just return the cell
1519	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1520	      return 0
1521	    fi
1522	
1523	    local error_class final_status
1524	    error_class="$(jq -r '.error_class // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1525	    final_status="$(jq -r '.final_status // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1526	
1527	    # If non-transient error or success, stop retrying
1528	    if [[ -z "${error_class}" ]] || ! is_transient_error_class "${error_class}"; then
1529	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1530	      return 0
1531	    fi
1532	
1533	    # If max attempts reached, mark final cell with transient_exhausted and stop
1534	    if (( attempt >= max_attempts )); then
1535	      local tmp
1536	      tmp="$(mktemp)"
1537	      jq '. + {final_status:"transient_exhausted"}' "${cell_dir}/report.json" >"${tmp}"
1538	      mv "${tmp}" "${cell_dir}/report.json"
1539	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1540	      return 0
1541	    fi
1542	
1543	    # Transient error and more attempts available: sleep and retry
1544	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}); sleeping ${backoff}s before retry"
1545	    sleep "${backoff}"
1546	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1547	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1548	    prior_cell_dir="${cell_dir}"
1549	  done
1550	}

1555	# the next cell. cap="" disables budget machinery entirely. interrupted_flag=""
1556	# disables interrupt checking. prior_cell_dir="" disables attempt_of tracking.
1557	budget_or_run_cell() {

1559	  local framework="$4" dataset="$5" dataset_dir="$6" task="$7"
1560	  local rep_idx="$8" total_reps="$9" adapter="${10}"

1562

1566	                  "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1567	                  "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${cap}" "${te_ver}" "${hd}")"

1571	
1572	  cell_dir="$(run_cell_with_per_cell_retry "${out}" "${profile_id}" "${profile_file}" \
1573	                "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1574	                "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${adapter}" \
1575	                "${te_ver}" "${hd}" "${interrupted_flag}" "${prior_cell_dir}")"
1576	
1577	  if [[ -n "${cap}" && -f "${cell_dir}/report.json" ]]; then

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/common.sh — shared shell helpers for adapters

set -euo pipefail

# Helper: read JSON from stdin, emit error to stderr and exit 1
die_json_error() {
  local msg="$1"
  printf 'error parsing profile JSON: %s\n' "$msg" >&2
  exit 1
}

# Helper: extract string field from JSON, default to empty
jq_str() {
  local path="$1" default="${2:-.}"
  jq -r "${path} // \"${default}\"" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$default"
}

# Helper: emit install-spec JSON
emit_install_spec() {
  local install_cmd="$1"
  local artifact_source="$2"
  local binary_path="$3"
  local harbor_plugin="$4"
  jq -nc \
    --arg install_command "$install_cmd" \
    --arg artifact_source "$artifact_source" \
    --arg binary_path "$binary_path" \
    --arg harbor_plugin "$harbor_plugin" \
    '{install_command:$install_command, artifact_source:$artifact_source, binary_path:$binary_path, harbor_plugin:$harbor_plugin}'
}

# Helper: emit command-spec JSON
emit_command_spec() {
  local command_json="$1"
  local env_json="$2"
  local secret_keys_json="$3"
  jq -nc \
    --argjson command "$command_json" \
    --argjson env "$env_json" \
    --argjson secret_env_keys "$secret_keys_json" \
    '{command:$command, env:$env, secret_env_keys:$secret_env_keys}'
}

# Helper: read profile JSON from stdin
read_profile_json() {
  local json
  json="$(cat)" || die_json_error "failed to read stdin"
  [[ -n "$json" ]] || die_json_error "empty stdin"
  printf '%s' "$json"
}

# Helper: resolve API key from profile and environment
resolve_api_key() {
  local api_key_env="$1"
  local default="${2:-}"
  if [[ -z "$api_key_env" ]]; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return
  fi
  # Use indirect variable expansion to read the env var
  printf '%s' "${!api_key_env:-$default}"
}

# Helper: build command array JSON from argv list
build_command_array() {
  local argv=("$@")
  jq -nc --args '[$ARGS.positional[]]' "${argv[@]}"
}

1	# harness-adapters contract
2	
3	Each file under `scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/` is an executable shell
4	script that translates a benchmark profile into:
5	
6	1. an **install** description — how to stage the agent binary into the Harbor
7	   task container, and which Harbor adapter class to load;
8	2. a **command** description — the agent argv and the env (with secret keys
9	   flagged) that the benchmark runner forwards to the task executor.
10	
11	The current adapters are:
12	
13	```
14	fiz          claude       codex        opencode     pi
15	cost-probe   noop         dumb-script
16	```
17	
18	`fiz` is the native harness. `claude`, `codex`, `opencode`, `pi` are
19	wrapper harnesses; their `command` returns env consumed by the matching
20	`scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.<name>:<Name>Agent` class inside the
21	`fizeau-harbor-runner` container. `cost-probe`, `noop`, `dumb-script` are
22	calibration adapters that do not call any model.
23	
24	## Header convention
25	
26	Every adapter file starts with a single `# SUMMARY:` line on line 2 (after
27	the shebang). The summary is one sentence that names the adapter and
28	states what its `install` and `command` subcommands emit. The benchmark
29	runner's `./benchmark harness-adapters` listing greps for this header.
30	
31	```
32	#!/usr/bin/env bash
33	# SUMMARY: <one-line description>
34	```
35	
36	## Subcommands
37	
38	```
39	<name> install <agent-artifact-path>     -> install-spec.json on stdout
40	<name> command                           -> command-spec.json on stdout
41	                                            (reads profile JSON on stdin)
42	<name> --help                            -> usage on stderr, exit 2
43	```
44	
45	`install` is invoked once per adapter per sweep; `command` is invoked once
46	per cell (profile × task × rep) on the runner's hot path, so it must be
47	fast and side-effect-free.
48	
49	## install-spec.json
50	
51	```json
52	{
53	  "install_command":  "install -m 0755 /path/to/fiz /installed-agent/fiz",
54	  "artifact_source":  "/path/to/fiz",
55	  "binary_path":      "/installed-agent/fiz",
56	  "harbor_plugin":    "scripts.benchmark.harbor_agent:FizeauAgent"
57	}
58	```
59	
60	- `install_command` — single shell command, executed once on the host (or
61	  inside the harbor-runner container, depending on the executor) to stage
62	  the artifact. May be `"true"` for calibration adapters.
63	- `artifact_source` — the host path that was passed as
64	  `<agent-artifact-path>`. Echoed back for provenance.
65	- `binary_path` — the in-container path where the binary lands. Empty for
66	  calibration adapters.
67	- `harbor_plugin` — Python import path Harbor will load via
68	  `--agent-import-path`. `null` for calibration adapters that bypass
69	  Harbor (they emit a `command` directly runnable inside the task).
70	
71	## command-spec.json
72	
73	Input is profile JSON on stdin with at least the following keys (other
74	keys are passed through and may be referenced by individual adapters):
75	
76	```json
77	{
78	  "id":       "vidar-ds4",
79	  "provider": {"type": "...", "model": "...", "base_url": "...", "api_key_env": "..."},
80	  "sampling": {"temperature": 0.6, "reasoning": "low", "planning_mode": true, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 20, "min_p": 0},
81	  "limits":   {"max_output_tokens": 65536, "context_tokens": 180000},
82	  "metadata": {"runtime": "...", ...}
83	}
84	```
85	
86	`metadata` is optional in the checked-in profile catalog; adapters use it
87	when present but do not require it for command-spec generation.
88	
89	`sampling` field schema (all keys optional; adapters omit env vars for
90	unset keys):
91	
92	| key              | type    | default | meaning                                                            |
93	| ---------------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
94	| `temperature`    | float   | unset   | sampler temperature                                                |
95	| `top_p`          | float   | unset   | nucleus-sampling cutoff                                            |
96	| `top_k`          | int     | unset   | top-k cutoff                                                       |
97	| `min_p`          | float   | unset   | minimum-probability cutoff                                         |
98	| `reasoning`      | string  | `""`    | reasoning effort hint (`""`, `low`, `medium`, `high`)              |
99	| `planning_mode`  | bool    | `false` | run one pre-execution decomposition pass before the main tool loop |
100	
101	`planning_mode` is an explicit, per-profile opt-in. The `fiz` adapter
102	appends `--plan` to the agent argv and exports `FIZEAU_PLANNING_MODE=1`
103	when this field is `true`. There is no implicit coupling to any tool
104	preset (e.g. `benchmark`); profiles that want planning must set
105	`sampling.planning_mode: true`.
106	
107	Output:
108	
109	```json
110	{
111	  "command":         ["/installed-agent/fiz", "--json", "--preset", "default", "-p", "$HARBOR_INSTRUCTION"],
112	  "env":             {"FIZEAU_BASE_URL": "http://vidar:1234/v1", "FIZEAU_MODEL": "qwen3.6-27b", "FIZEAU_API_KEY": "${FOO_KEY}", "...": "..."},
113	  "secret_env_keys": ["FIZEAU_API_KEY"]
114	}
115	```
116	
117	- `command` — argv list. `$HARBOR_INSTRUCTION` and `${VAR}` strings remain
118	  unexpanded; the task executor (or harbor adapter) handles substitution
119	  at run time. For wrapper harnesses this argv is informational; Harbor
120	  invokes the agent via its plugin and uses `env`.
121	- `env` — env vars to forward into the container. Values containing
122	  `${VAR}` reference host env to be expanded by the task executor.
123	- `secret_env_keys` — subset of `env` keys whose values are secrets and
124	  must be redacted in any logged/recorded form. Order-insensitive,
125	  duplicate-free.
126	
127	## Determinism rules
128	
129	- `command` and `install_command` must be deterministic given the same
130	  profile and artifact path — no random suffixes, no timestamps, no
131	  filesystem temp-dir mkdtemp on the host. The runner relies on stable
132	  command-specs to compute cell content hashes.
133	- Calibration adapters (`cost-probe`, `noop`, `dumb-script`) must drain
134	  stdin (`cat >/dev/null`) before emitting their fixed JSON so callers
135	  can stream a profile in without backpressure.
136	
137	## Validation
138	
139	`./benchmark validate` calls every adapter's `command` against a synthetic
140	profile and rejects:
141	
142	- non-zero exit;
143	- output that is not valid JSON;
144	- output missing one of `{command, env, secret_env_keys}`;
145	- `secret_env_keys` entries not present in `env`.
146	
147	Adapters reject malformed or schema-invalid profile JSON on stdin before
148	emitting a command spec.
149	
150	`shellcheck` (CI gate) must pass on every file in this directory.
151

3	# benchmark_adapter_read_profile reads profile JSON from stdin, validates the
4	# documented schema, and prints a compact JSON copy on stdout.
5	benchmark_adapter_read_profile() {
6	  local adapter="$1"
7	  local profile_json validated err_file
8	
9	  profile_json="$(cat)"
10	  if [[ -z "${profile_json}" ]]; then
11	    printf '%s: empty profile JSON on stdin\n' "${adapter}" >&2
12	    return 2
13	  fi
14	
15	  err_file="$(mktemp)"
16	  if ! validated="$(jq -c -e '
17	    def req(cond; msg): if cond then . else error(msg) end;
18	    req(type == "object"; "profile JSON must be a JSON object")
19	    | req(has("id") and (.id | type == "string" and length > 0); "missing required field .id")
20	    | req(has("provider") and (.provider | type == "object"); "missing required field .provider")
21	    | req(.provider | has("type") and (.type | type == "string" and length > 0); "missing required field .provider.type")
22	    | req(.provider | has("model") and (.model | type == "string" and length > 0); "missing required field .provider.model")
23	    | req(.provider | has("base_url") and (.base_url | type == "string" and length > 0); "missing required field .provider.base_url")
24	    | req(.provider | has("api_key_env") and (.api_key_env | type == "string" and length > 0); "missing required field .provider.api_key_env")
25	    | if has("sampling") then req(.sampling | type == "object"; ".sampling must be an object") else . end
26	    | if has("limits") then req(.limits | type == "object"; ".limits must be an object") else . end
27	  ' <<<"${profile_json}" 2>"${err_file}")"; then
28	    printf '%s: %s\n' "${adapter}" "$(tr -d '\n' <"${err_file}")" >&2
29	    rm -f "${err_file}"
30	    return 2
31	  fi
32	
33	  rm -f "${err_file}"
34	  printf '%s\n' "${validated}"
35	}
